obligations.title: Deliver monthly report on performance against Service Levels, incidents, notification times and credits accrued.
Maintain administrative, technical and physical safeguards protecting the Services and Customer Confidential Information.
Return or securely delete Customer Materials and Confidential Information on request after termination or expiry.
Cooperate in good faith on orderly transition of the Services after termination or expiry.
Attempt dispute resolution through good-faith senior executive discussions before starting court proceedings.
